tools.name: verify_email
tools.description: Full check of one address: RFC syntax and normalisation, domain existence and MX records (incl. null-MX and implicit-MX), disposable-provider list (10k+ domains), role account, free-mail provider, typo suggestion; optional SMTP RCPT probe with catch-all detection and optional SPF/DMARC. Example: ema

tools.name: verify_emails
tools.description: Same checks as verify_email for a list, run in parallel with per-domain DNS caching; returns per-address results, a summary by status, and `clean` (the deliverable ones). Charged per unique address. Example: emails ['a@x.com','b@y.org'], smtp_check false. Response: result with status (deliverable |

tools.name: domain_check
tools.description: Does the domain accept mail, which MX hosts, is it a disposable or free-mail provider, does it publish SPF and DMARC (and the DMARC policy)? Use before trusting a sender domain or when onboarding a company. Example: domain 'noahsarch.tech'. Response: result with status (deliverable | risky | undeliv

tools.name: extract_emails
tools.description: Find every address in a block of text or HTML (deduped by default). Free. Pair with verify_emails. Response: result with status (deliverable | risky | undeliverable | invalid | unknown), reason, score 0–100, the checks run, plus data_confidence, estimated_items[], sources[], data_version, warnings[]

tools.name: suggest_fix
tools.description: Fix common typos: gmial.com, hotmail.con, yaho.com, stray spaces/dots. Returns the suggestion (or null) and which fixes applied. Free. Example: email 'sara@gmial.con'. Response: result with status (deliverable | risky | undeliverable | invalid | unknown), reason, score 0–100, the checks run, plus da

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: verify_email, verify_emails · Private data: verify_email · Public sink: verify_email, domain_check, suggest_fix · Destructive: verify_email, verify_emails, domain_check, extract_emails, suggest_fix.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: verify_email, verify_emails · Private data: verify_email · Public sink: verify_email, domain_check, suggest_fix · Destructive: verify_email, verify_emails, domain_check, extract_emails, suggest_fix

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
